title: Where is it?
goal: I can describe where things are.
grammarFocus: Where is it? — It is in/on/under...

vocab.example: The ball is in the box so I can't see it.
The book is on the table next to my cup.
The cat is under the chair because it is sleepy.
Is the toy in the box or on the table?
Put the book on the table please.
The dog is under the chair and the cat is on it!
Where is the ball? I think it is under the bed.
The book on the table is my favorite story.
